title: Album Cover Similarity Analysis
text:
How Similarity Is Measured
Album covers were analyzed across two visual dimensions:

Color (HSV Palette): Compares the distribution of hue, color saturation, and brightness across the image.
Design (Spatial Composition): Compares the spatial layout, balance of light and dark regions, and structural composition.

Scores range from -1.0 (complete opposites) to +1.0 (virtually identical).
